original.statement: The legacy metrics argocd_app_sync_status, argocd_app_health_status and argocd_app_created_time are removed in 3.0.0; use labels on argocd_app_info instead, which matters if ARGOCD_LEGACY_CONTROLLER_METRICS is set to true.

decision.reason: The Detection section of [ev-06e920b4a3dd] says these metrics are only available when `ARGOCD_LEGACY_CONTROLLER_METRICS` is explicitly set to `true`, and that if it is not set to true you can safely upgrade with no changes. So the exposure is exactly env-var ARGOCD_LEGACY_CONTROLLER_METRICS equals "true": environments without that setting never had the metrics and are not affected. The proposed condition is neither broader nor narrower than what the evidence states.
